trousers.note: Deep umber separates the legs from the apron.

oiled hide.note: Dark leather for soles, bracers and the sling.

saddle.note: Ochre leather makes the vest and gloves legible against the spheres.

linen.note: Warm unbleached linen on the chest and sleeves.

rolled linen.note: A darker edge defines the rolled cuff.

skin.note: Separate forearms and cheeks from linen.

chestnut.note: Warm chestnut highlights show the swept tufts.

right eye.note: A dark iris on sunlit skin.

left eye.note: Match the right iris; measure each separately.

amethyst.note: Push the dusty reference purple above the warm leather.

lilac.note: The reverse of the bandanna and the sash border catch light.

brass.note: Warm rims against the two cool lenses.

aqua glass.note: Increase cyan contrast at final resolution.

black iron.note: A cool graphite ramp preserves the spherical highlights.

hemp.note: Warm twisted cord on the belt and fuse.

tool steel.note: A cool chisel edge over the back of the jerkin.
